ADVENTURER_HUD.Title: Adventurer HUD
ADVENTURER_HUD.Keybindings.Open.Name: Toggle Adventurer HUD
ADVENTURER_HUD.Keybindings.Open.Hint: Toggle the HUD for your selected token or assigned character. Change the shortcut in Foundry.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Actor.TokenNotOnScene: This character has no token on the current scene.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.companionAutoFoc: Select the token, use its configured vision and center the camera when opening a companion or returning to your character. Applies to tokens on the current scene.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.pinWindow.Name: Pin player panel
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.pinWindow.Hint: Keep the player panel in place and prevent resizing.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmPinWindow.Name: Pin GM panel
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmPinWindow.Hint: Keep the GM panel in place and prevent resizing.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.closeOnEscape.Hi: Allow Escape to close the HUD, including pinned panels. Disabled by default.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.separateModeSize: Remember the player panel's width and height separately for exploration and combat. Pinned panels keep their size. Disabled by default.
Show the current width and height in the HUD header while resizing.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.autoScrollExpand: Reveal newly opened companions, favorites, exploration sections and combat categories. Tall sections scroll to their beginning; the other column stays in place. Spell levels keep their normal scrolling.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.twoColumnWidth.H: HUD window width for switching to two columns in exploration and combat: 450–1200 pixels. Widths below 450 keep a single column. Uses the debug indicator width.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showTokenControl: Open the HUD from Token Controls.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.fontSize.Name: Text size
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.fontSize.Hint: Size of HUD text and values.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showVisualEffect: Flashes and glow. HP colors stay visible when off.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.language.Name: HUD language
Follow controlled tokens while the HUD is open. With no token selected, use the assigned character. This does not open a closed HUD.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.autoOpenHud.Name: Open on login
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.autoOpenHud.Hint: Open your HUD on login or refresh. Uses the assigned character or your available character choice; token following is a separate preference.
Attack, damage, save DC, and spell tags. Range, charges, and costs stay visible.
Show separate combat category buttons at every width. Click the active category to collapse it. Hidden categories still appear in character search.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showModeNavigati: Manual choice overrides automatic mode until reopening the HUD or hiding these buttons.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showShortcuts.Hi: Show roll modifiers at the bottom of the left column: Shift for quick rolls, Alt/Ctrl for advantage/disadvantage, Ctrl+left-click to remove an effect. Move or hide these hints in the character editor.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showSearch.Name: Character search
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showSearch.Hint: Enable player search across all character items, activities and rolls. The editor can hide this panel for a character in both modes; restore it in Hidden elements. Enabling this setting does not undo editor hiding.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showFavorites.Hi: Enable the Favorites panel and stars on item/activity cards. Hiding the panel in the character editor keeps the stars and native favorites.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Advanced.Name: Additional settings
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Advanced.Hint: Quick access, cards, and display options.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Advanced.Label: Configure
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Reset.Name: Reset HUD settings
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Reset.Label: Reset settings
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Reset.Confirm: Restore default HUD settings? Favorites, saved panels, and window size and position are kept.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Warnings.NoActor: Select a token or assign a character to your user.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Warnings.NoPermission: You do not have permission to roll for this character.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Warnings.UnsupportedActor: {actor} is not supported by the active system adapter.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Skills.EmptyFiltered: No proficient skills yet. Select All skills to see every skill.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Quick.EmptyFavoritesHint: Click the star beside an item or activity to add it to favorites.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Initiative.SelectToken: Select a token to roll initiative
ADVENTURER_HUD.Initiative.NoCombat: The GM must create a Combat Encounter first
ADVENTURER_HUD.Initiative.NotCombatant: The GM must add this token to the Combat Encounter
ADVENTURER_HUD.Window.ResetHint: Reset the window size and position
ADVENTURER_HUD.Window.Pin: Pin panel: lock position and size
ADVENTURER_HUD.Window.Unpin: Unpin panel: allow moving and resizing
ADVENTURER_HUD.Window.Title: Exploration — {actor}

ADVENTURER_HUD.Combat.NotAvailable: Combat mode is available only for character actors.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Combat.HealToMaxHint: Shift+click to restore HP to maximum
ADVENTURER_HUD.Combat.HPInputHint: Leave blank to keep the current value. A number sets HP; +5 adds HP. -3 removes temporary HP first, then HP. The temporary HP field changes temporary HP directly.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Combat.OpenDescriptionHin: Open item · Shift + click: send description to chat
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showActivityPick: Choose an item's activity in the HUD, or use the system dialog when off.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Shortcuts.Hint: Modifier keys depend on the D&D 5e and Midi-QOL settings
ADVENTURER_HUD.Shortcuts.Aria: Shift: fast roll; Alt: advantage; Control: disadvantage
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.openPlayerOnComb: Open player HUD when added to combat
Open a closed player HUD when your assigned character joins combat on this scene. An already open HUD switches to combat regardless of this setting. Disabled by default.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Quick.NoPermission: You cannot use this character’s items.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Quick.ItemUnavailable: This item is unavailable or hidden.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Integrity.Name: HUD integrity
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Integrity.Label: Check integrity
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Integrity.Hint: Check module data and files, repair preferences or download an error report.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Integrity.Title: HUD integrity
ADVENTURER_HUD.Integrity.Intro: Checks saved preferences, panel layouts, installed files, and required system features. Repairs preserve valid preferences and save a backup.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Integrity.NotChecked: Run a check to see if repairs are needed.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Integrity.Healthy: No problems found in the checks performed.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Integrity.Found: Problems found. Review the list before repairing.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Integrity.Failed: The operation failed. Check the browser console for details and try again.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Integrity.Repaired: Repaired entries: {count}. A backup was saved.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Integrity.ManualHint: Missing files and system features cannot be restored here. Reload the game; if the problem persists, update compatible Foundry/D&D versions or reinstall the module. The check does not validate every function or restore removed code.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showCombatSkills: Show Skills in combat, including proficient tools. Hiding the tab does not remove its rolls from character search.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.GM.Name: GM settings
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.GM.Label: Configure GM
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.GM.Hint: Personal preferences for the GM combat preset.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmEnabled.Name: Use GM panel
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmEnabled.Hint: Use the combat HUD for creatures in the current scene.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmFollowTurn.Hin: Select the active NPC. Player turns keep the last NPC card.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmAutoAdvance.Hi: Select the next undefeated NPC without skipping player turns.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmIncludePlayerN: Also list NPCs controlled by active players.

ADVENTURER_HUD.GM.NoCreatures: No GM creatures in this combat. Add NPC tokens in the combat tracker.
ADVENTURER_HUD.GM.NoCombat: No combat on this scene yet.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmHideSearch.Hin: Enable GM search independently of player search. If hidden for this token in the editor, restore it in Hidden elements.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmActionTypesOnl: Only action types in GM mode
Hide Weapons and Spells tabs. Keep Features and group activities by action type, including custom types.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmShowAttackDeta: Show system-calculated attack bonuses and save DCs.
Allow current-turn selection of defeated creatures and highlight them.
ADVENTURER_HUD.GM.ResetInitiativeHint: Right-click to reset this creature's initiative
ADVENTURER_HUD.GM.NoPlayers: No player characters in this combat. Add their tokens from the scene.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmOpenOnCombat.H: Open the GM HUD for preparation when a combat is created on this scene.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmCloseAfterComb: Close the GM HUD when its selected combat ends, including pinned windows.
ADVENTURER_HUD.GM.RemoveDeadConfirm: Delete defeated NPC tokens from this combat? Directory actors are kept.
ADVENTURER_HUD.GM.NoTokensRemoved: No tokens were removed. Check the selected combat and defeated status.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Keybindings.GM.Hint: Works while the GM HUD is open. Assign a shortcut in Foundry keybindings.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.theme.Name: HUD theme
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.theme.Hint: Applied immediately, independently of the Foundry theme.

ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.VisionDuration: Until your next turn · outside combat: 6 seconds of game time
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.VisionOwnTurn: Sharing senses uses a Bonus Action. Activate it on your character's turn in the current encounter.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.VisionDisabled: Enable vision on this token first.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.VisionUnavaila: A creature at 0 HP cannot share its senses.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.VisionAlreadyA: Stop the current shared senses before choosing another.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.OffScene: No token on the current scene
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.Empty: No other owned characters or creatures.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.Unavailable: Companion is unavailable or ownership has changed.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.NoPermission: Ownership of both the character and companion is required.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.RollAllHint: Roll each owned companion token in the current encounter, keeping existing results.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.NothingToRoll: No companions to roll: add their tokens to the current encounter or choose a specific token. Existing initiative is kept.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showCompanions.H: Show all owned characters and creatures except your main character, with On scene selected by default.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showCompanionEff: Show active condition and buff icons beneath each companion card in the list.
Show action type tabs. Disable to display all abilities in one list, including legendary actions and items without activities.

ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmCardDetails.Hi: GM card details are independent of player settings. Range, charges and action cost stay visible.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.gmShowItemDetail: Show damage and spell tags in GM cards.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.EmptyScene: No companions on this scene. Open All to add one.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.VisionUnsuppor: Shared vision is unavailable: the native token vision API could not be initialized.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.showItemDescript: Show descriptions when hovering or focusing item cards.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Diagnostics.IncludeErrors: Include cleaned error text (may contain world data; review before sharing)
ADVENTURER_HUD.Diagnostics.Privacy: Stored only in this tab and lost on reload. No automatic upload. Documents, descriptions and search text are excluded. Detailed recording stops after 10 minutes.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Diagnostics.NotRecording: Detailed recording is off. Recent HUD actions and errors are available.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Diagnostics.Summary: Errors: {errors}; refusals: {refusals}; events: {events}; omitted: {dropped}; about {size} KB.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Diagnostics.Sections: Report: versions and modules, HUD settings and context, anonymous document references, action history, recording and integrity results (if checked).
ADVENTURER_HUD.Combat.EmptyActiveFeature: No features with an activation. Switch to passive features.

ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Companions.Label: Configure companions
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.Companions.Hint: Companion panel, effects, token selection and shared-senses camera.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.slidePanel.Name: Slide HUD to the screen edge
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.slidePanel.Hint: Hide the panel beyond the nearest screen edge when closing and slide it back when opening. Disabled by default.

ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.VisionNotFamil: Requires a familiar summoned through this character's Find Familiar activity.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Companions.VisionIncapaci: An incapacitated character cannot share familiar senses.

ADVENTURER_HUD.Troubleshooting.ResetAllH: Reset personal player/GM settings, all HUD block and card layouts, and window sizes/positions. Native favorites are preserved.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Troubleshooting.BackupHin: Save your HUD settings and window layouts to a JSON file, or restore them from a backup. Actor data and native favorites are not included.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Troubleshooting.RestoreHi: Choose an Adventurer HUD settings backup. Settings present in the file will replace your current values.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Troubleshooting.BackupInv: This file is not a valid Adventurer HUD settings backup.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Troubleshooting.BackupRes: HUD settings restored. Saved window sizes and positions apply when the HUD is next opened.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.companionVisionP: Center on the companion when sharing senses and return to your character when the link ends.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Combat.EmptyPassiveFeatur: No passive features. Switch to active features.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Troubleshooting.ReportHel: Describe the problem and download the report to share with support.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Troubleshooting.Recording: Start recording, reproduce the problem in the HUD, then mark when it happened.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Troubleshooting.SaveHint: Report, backup and repair actions run immediately.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Settings.playerFooter.Hin: Move effects, End turn, ping and token focus into a fixed bottom toolbar in both player modes.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Troubleshooting.RestorePa: Restore failed and some previous values could not be recovered. Check the settings before continuing.
ADVENTURER_HUD.Troubleshooting.RestoreRo: Restore failed. Your previous settings have been preserved.
ADVENTURER_HUD.HudLayout.Hint: Drag block handles or use arrows. Open a tab to arrange its cards. Changes save automatically.
